modelingNotes: Displayed values are illustrative mockup data, not output from an implemented simulation engine or live IoT feed.
The prototype timer only previews completion. It is not an implemented background task.
Saving a SimulationScenario draft does not create a SimulationRun.
The handoff prefills a new form and does not persist, approve or physically execute a RedistributionPlan.
The report imports only one representative UI per UC. Detailed prototype states stay in Figma.
The existing two sequence, two activity and SimulationRun state diagrams are retained unchanged.
